patterns.note: Sections are full-width with generous vertical spacing, often using a grid-like structure for content blocks within a section, all set against a dominant black background.
Exclusive use of a distinct, blocky, monospaced display font for all text elements, from large headings to body copy, creating a consistent retro-digital aesthetic.
A high-contrast color scheme featuring a dominant black background with white text, accented by vibrant, almost neon, pink, green, blue, and cyan for interactive elements and UI borders.

The initial full-screen hero experience completely collapses and disappears on scroll, revealing the main content. The navigation bar transforms its size, background, and menu presentation (from inline to a hamburger icon) as it becomes sticky after the hero section.
Sections are visually delineated by thin, dashed line borders and bracket-like UI elements, reinforcing a digital interface or terminal screen aesthetic.

technique_notes: The site employs a full-screen interactive hero that is designed to completely collapse and disappear from view as the user initiates scrolling, transitioning to the main content.

A sticky header navigation dynamically changes its visual properties, including its height, background color, and the layout of its menu items (from a horizontal list to a hamburger icon), once the user scrolls past the initial hero section.
Content sections are introduced with a subtle fade-up or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic and engaging reveal sequence during scrolling.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, uppercase headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, also uppercase, body text, all using a distinct blocky, monospaced font.
design_tokens.spacing: airy in the hero and between major sections, with balanced density within content grids.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its immersive, retro-futuristic digital interface aesthetic, achieved through the consistent application of a blocky, monospaced font, high-contrast neon accents, and UI elements that evoke old-school computer terminals. The interactive hero and transforming sticky navigation further enhance this unique brand identity.
